_comment: Safety baseline for verify-sports-sync.test.ts broadcast/deployment guard. `byteForByte` entries must not change at all — a hash mismatch means streaming, broadcast, auth or deployment config was touched. `localisedOnly` entries are UI files the i18n work deliberately edited (each diff reviewed as strings and imports only); their hash is pinned so any FURTHER edit fails, and the test separately asserts the streaming behaviour they own, because a hash cannot tell a translation from a logic change. `views/match-detail.tsx` is the relocated `app/matches/[slug]/page.tsx` — a page view, so it belongs with the localised UI files, not with the infrastructure that must never move. These three hashes were re-pinned once more when the broadcast notice under the stream player was routed through `broadcastNoticeKey` instead of being passed to the player as raw Arabic; that diff was imports, one prop expression and comments, with no logic change. vercel.json was deliberately changed once more (2026-10-14, universal fixture discovery) to schedule /api/cron/discover-fixtures daily and the sports-sync catalog/tick jobs; only cron entries were added, no existing entry, header or rewrite moved, and its hash was re-pinned for that reviewed change. views/match-detail.tsx was re-pinned once more (2026-10-15, editorial matchdays 15–16 October 2026): a declared-TV-channels section (#channels), the round label in the kickoff line and locale-aware team/competition labels were added. A second reviewed edit in the same turn added the locale-aware competition label (fixtureCompetitionLabel) and hid the Arabic round label on English pages. Both diffs are display-only — the stream registry call, the override read, the player mount and the calendar link are untouched, and the three behaviour assertions below still pin them. next.config.ts was deliberately changed once (2026-10-15, hosted-preview support): the headers() block now reads NEMO_PREVIEW_FRAME_ORIGINS (lib/security-csp.ts) and, ONLY when it names at least one origin, replaces `frame-ancestors 'none'` with `'self' <origins>` and omits `X-Frame-Options: DENY` (which cannot express an allowlist). The review saw no other edit: the strict default, the other five headers, the HSTS rule and the /ad-frame override are untouched, and the broadcast/deployment guard now asserts that behaviour directly (siteFrameAncestors([]) === 'none', garbage origins dropped, opt-in shape) instead of trusting the hash alone. Unset in CI and production. On 2026-10-19 vercel.json was deliberately reduced from nine to the two unchanged daily ingest/news crons for Vercel Hobby; each removed route is scheduled with the same Bearer gate from .github/workflows/league-refresh.yml or data-maintenance.yml, and refresh-maintenance.test.mjs pins both remaining crons and the replacement paths. Only the vercel.json hash was re-pinned.
